cross_cutting_meta_rules.name: Atomic lockstep (documentary)
cross_cutting_meta_rules.rule_text: R-37 (atomic lockstep) is DOCUMENTARY across the entire governance surface — there is NO write-time DENY, by design. A PreToolUse hook sees exactly one file per call and cannot inspect a multi-file commit set. Enforcement = git's commit-boundary atomicity + the librarian governance-parity-audit capability at session-close. The lockstep set = pillar JSON + hooks + CLAUDE.md.
cross_cutting_meta_rules.failure_mode: Drift from partial landings of a multi-surface change. Caught at git commit-boundary + audit-time, never write-time.

cross_cutting_meta_rules.name: Stage-gated promotion framework
cross_cutting_meta_rules.rule_text: Tier 1 advisory + promotion_criterion. Clean data -> promote to a blocking tier; no data -> retire. Stage-gated promotion, never ossify, never promote without data.
cross_cutting_meta_rules.failure_mode: Ossify (advisory forever) or promote without data.

cross_cutting_meta_rules.name: Self-healing boundary
cross_cutting_meta_rules.rule_text: Mechanical drift auto-fixes (librarian regenerates mechanically-derivable values); semantic drift self-flags for review, never auto-overwritten.
cross_cutting_meta_rules.failure_mode: Over-reach (auto-overwriting semantic content) or under-reach (failing to auto-fix mechanical drift).

cross_cutting_meta_rules.name: Layer-3 Overlay Collision Tiebreaker
enforcement_layer: pre-write-guard.sh write-time DENY on shadowing writes missing `_override_reason`
version-control merge-conflict surfacing on foundation upgrades touching shadowed entries
cross_cutting_meta_rules.rule_text: When adopter Layer-3 overlay and foundation canonical both declare the same rule ID or extensible entry kind: adopter Layer-3 SHADOWS foundation (adopter wins). Foundation declaration is preserved but does not fire. Adopter MUST carry `_override_reason` (free-text, mandatory) on every shadowing entry. Write-time DENY on shadowing writes without `_override_reason`; per-write `--force-override` bypass; no persistent disable.
cross_cutting_meta_rules.failure_mode: Silent collisions between adopter customization and foundation canonical produce unpredictable runtime behavior — rules with the same ID compete; overlay edits silently disable foundation rules.

cross_cutting_meta_rules.name: Dead-path tripwire
cross_cutting_meta_rules.rule_text: Writes to a declared dead path are DENIED. Ships with an EMPTY tripwire_paths[] (no dead paths declared at v1.0.0); the mechanism is present for adopters/future use.
cross_cutting_meta_rules.failure_mode: A write to a known-retired path lands silently. Empty tripwire_paths at ship means no-op by default.

cross_cutting_meta_rules.name: Skill-change protocol
cross_cutting_meta_rules.rule_text: Editing a skill (SKILL.md / process.sh) surfaces the change-protocol checklist (save memory, update docs, grep downstream). Advisory.
cross_cutting_meta_rules.failure_mode: A skill changes without the cross-surface propagation protocol.

cross_cutting_meta_rules.name: librarian-manifest staleness audit
cross_cutting_meta_rules.rule_text: The librarian-manifest read-replica is audited for staleness against the foundation surface. Audit-tier (librarian), not write-time.
cross_cutting_meta_rules.failure_mode: librarian-manifest.json drifts stale against the real foundation surface.

cross_cutting_meta_rules.name: Bypass/override abuse audit
cross_cutting_meta_rules.rule_text: Bypass/override usage (governance escape hatches, --force flags, bypass env vars) is audited for abuse patterns. Audit-tier (librarian).
cross_cutting_meta_rules.failure_mode: Escape hatches used routinely rather than exceptionally; governance silently eroded.

cross_cutting_meta_rules.name: Protected SessionEnd hooks
cross_cutting_meta_rules.rule_text: Edits that would disable the claude-mem SessionEnd hook are DENIED (CLAUDE_MEM_DISABLE_OK=1 escape hatch). Load-bearing for auto-memory.
cross_cutting_meta_rules.failure_mode: claude-mem SessionEnd hook disabled; auto-memory silently stops persisting.

cross_cutting_meta_rules.name: Checkpoint freshness gate
cross_cutting_meta_rules.rule_text: At context pressure thresholds, a fresh per-session checkpoint is required; the Stop hook gates until the checkpoint is fresh (< 10 min). Safety valve preserved above the high-pressure ceiling.
cross_cutting_meta_rules.failure_mode: A long session compacts without a fresh checkpoint; session continuity state is lost.

cross_cutting_meta_rules.name: Default session-register hook loop
cross_cutting_meta_rules.rule_text: The default SessionStart hook loop (session-register -> track-vault-write -> prompt-context) wires the multi-session coordination + context-injection band. Advisory framing.
cross_cutting_meta_rules.failure_mode: The default session-wiring loop is broken or mis-ordered; coordination + context-injection degrade.

cross_cutting_meta_rules.name: Memory-file frontmatter
cross_cutting_meta_rules.rule_text: Memory files (memory/<topic>.md) carry the required frontmatter shape (description/tags). Advisory.
cross_cutting_meta_rules.failure_mode: Memory files without frontmatter are mis-indexed in MEMORY.md / mis-resolved by retrieval.

cross_cutting_meta_rules.name: plan-index staleness audit
cross_cutting_meta_rules.rule_text: The librarian plan-index read-replica is audited for staleness against the plans-tree. Audit-tier.
cross_cutting_meta_rules.failure_mode: _index.md plan-index drifts stale against the real plans-tree.

cross_cutting_meta_rules.name: cron-wrapper bash-3.2
cross_cutting_meta_rules.rule_text: cron wrappers + shipped hook bodies must be bash-3.2 clean (no associative arrays, no bash-4 builtins, no param-expansion case-conversion). DENY on violation.
cross_cutting_meta_rules.failure_mode: A bash-4 construct ships in a wrapper/hook and fails on the macOS default bash 3.2.

cross_cutting_meta_rules.name: auto-commit silent-failure
cross_cutting_meta_rules.rule_text: Auto-commit silent-failure is detected + surfaced (now default-on). Advisory.
cross_cutting_meta_rules.failure_mode: An auto-commit silently fails; expected state never lands in git.

dissolved_schemas._description: Registry of schemas that were semantically dissolved into pillars or the foundation-master bundle. 'Dissolved' = no new authoring; canonical authority lives at the named successors. Each entry carries `frozen_at` and `successors`.

schemas/vault-schema.json.status: DISSOLVED AND REMOVED — the file no longer ships; the named successors are canonical.

governance/enforcement-map.schema.json.reason: Retired entirely; rule-shape validation migrates. Validator pointer redirected to governance/foundation-master.json — the populated 8-pillar bundle already conforms to the rule shapes the retired schema defined, so it serves as the rule-shape attestation surface post-retirement.
